command:
set -eu
mkfs.xfs -f -L APPDATA /dev/vg_appdata/data
install -d -m 0755 /srv/data /usr/local/sbin
cat > /usr/local/sbin/appdata-loop-setup <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
image=/var/lib/appdata-storage/appdata-lvm.img
loopdev=$(losetup -j "$image" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p')
if [ -z "$loopdev" ]; then
  loopdev=$(losetup --find --show "$image")
fi
lvmdevices --adddev "$loopdev" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
pvscan --cache "$loopdev" >/dev/null
vgchange -ay vg_appdata >/dev/null
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/appdata-loop-setup
cat > /etc/systemd/system/appdata-loop.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop-backed LVM storage for application data
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-remount-fs.service
Before=local-fs-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/appdata-loop-setup
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
if ! grep -q '^/dev/mapper/vg_appdata-data /srv/data ' /etc/fstab; then
  printf '%s\n' '/dev/mapper/vg_appdata-data /srv/data xfs defaults,nofail,x-systemd.requires=appdata-loop.service,x-systemd.after=appdata-loop.service 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
fi
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable appdata-loop.service
mount /srv/data
findmnt -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /srv/data
systemctl is-enabled appdata-loop.service
